I told Pree in her #central-team thread that the settled figure is **87 seats** for Marrow Fieldworks' 2026 renewal.

That number comes from Hollis's correction in #central-team on the 14th. He first posted 268, then changed it to 87 the same morning because he'd read the wrong line. Nothing in the channel has changed it since. Pree is a member of the channel, so she can see both posts herself.

The brain still lists the old 268 next to 87, because my earlier attempts to remove it failed. I told Pree to ignore it. I also mentioned that I can't see any Marrow Fieldworks contract or account files. So 87 rests on what Hollis said and hasn't been checked against the paperwork.
